hub.speaker: Market-Tier Local
hub.text: Busy morning for the stalls. Mind the queues — they move faster than they look.

text_variants.text: Don't see many of you up this tier. Nothing personal in the look — just not a common one.
You'll want the second queue — the first one's for out-of-towners. You know how it is.

text_variants._comment: v0.15 T4.1 market ambient reactivity. Ordered AFTER the race reads on purpose (last match wins): once the tier's own chain has moved, the region acknowledging it beats a first-meeting read. No shipped pallass fixture banks either counter, so every pinned canonical still lands on the base or race text.
text_variants.text: Forge-tier stamp on you. Then you've met our queues properly. The second window's the slow one, whatever the sign claims.
Word came up the shaft about Liscor and whatever sat under it. I sold three lamps off the strength of that story this morning, so I'll not complain.

options.text: Anything on you worth my coin?
